thesis: CoreWeave, Inc. rents specialized graphics processing unit (GPU) cloud infrastructure to artificial intelligence labs and enterprises. **[Fact]** The company operates AI-native data centers built around NVIDIA GPU clusters (GB200/GB300 systems, InfiniBand networking) and sells compute, storage, and orchestration services under long-term contracts. **[Fact]** FY2025 revenue was **$5.1 billion** (up from **$1.9 billion** in 2024 and **$229 million** in 2023). **[Fact]** At December 31, 2025, remaining performance obligations (contract backlog) totaled **$60.7 billion** versus **$15.1 billion** a year earlier, with a weighted-average contract duration of about **five years**. **[Fact]** The company remains loss-making at the net income line: **$1.2 billion** net loss in FY2025 and **$740 million** in Q1 2026, while reporting **$3.1 billion** of net cash from operating activities in FY2025. **[Fact]** Total debt was **$25.1 billion** at March 31, 2026.
why_market_wrong: **Predictive attribute:** growth narrative versus leverage (headline revenue and backlog versus interest expense, customer concentration, and refinancing risk).
